editorial_policy.keep_single_source_of_truth: Canonical chapter body is referenced by ID and exact original Git blob; do not duplicate body in each theme.
editorial_policy.thematic_pointers: Six reader routes reference chapter IDs; context references must not be treated as direct historical evidence.
editorial_policy.proposed_insertions: Do not auto-import into L1 master, Volume VIII, app routes or merged branches.
editorial_policy.source_evidence: Registered source URLs and research summaries are not primary manuscript collation. Citation scope follows each claim.
editorial_policy.public_release: Require expert history review, actual reader test, rights checks and app E2E first.
editorial_policy.fallback: If exact chapter ID or source hash mismatch, fail closed rather than falling back to similarly titled material.
